# ---- Shared building blocks (spec/FORMAT.md: "Group codes", "Invites", "Group fingerprint", "Plus Codes",
# "Check-ins", "Reports about others", "Are you safe?", "Places"). Generated by an independent Python implementation.
# Lists are written as `a,b` (needs) or space-separated (indices); a missing field means "none".

# Group code clean-up: normalizeCode(input) == output; isGeneratedCode(output) == generated.
kind: code-normalize
input: k7qf 2m9x pa4t w8rj
output: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
generated: true

kind: code-normalize
input: K7QF2M9XPA4TW8RJ
output: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
generated: true

# Underscore, en dash, and an em dash followed by a no-break space between the groups.
kind: code-normalize
input: k7qf_2m9x–pa4t— w8rj
output: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
generated: true

# Leading and trailing spaces, a tab and line breaks: "  k7qf-2m9x<TAB>pa4t<LF>w8rj <LF>".
kind: code-normalize
input_hex: 20206b3771662d326d397809706134740a7738726a200a
output: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
generated: true

kind: code-normalize
input: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
output: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
generated: true

# A 16-letter custom code made only of code symbols is taken for a generated one.
kind: code-normalize
input: abcdefghjkmnpqrs
output: ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS
generated: true

kind: code-normalize
input: darkproof://join?name=Family&code=K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
output: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
generated: true

# The code of a link is taken exactly as it is, even in lower case.
kind: code-normalize
input: https://darkproof.app/join#name=Family&code=k7qf-2m9x-pa4t-w8rj
output: k7qf-2m9x-pa4t-w8rj
generated: false

kind: code-normalize
input: test-group-1
output: test-group-1
generated: false

kind: code-normalize
input: blackout-public
output: blackout-public
generated: false

# 0 is not a code symbol: a custom code, kept as typed.
kind: code-normalize
input: k7qf-2m9x-pa4t-w8r0
output: k7qf-2m9x-pa4t-w8r0
generated: false

kind: code-normalize

output: k7qf-2m9x-pa4t-w8rjx
generated: false

# A custom code is only trimmed: " Oma Gisela 1950 <LF>".
kind: code-normalize
input_hex: 204f6d6120476973656c612031393530200a
output: Oma Gisela 1950
generated: false

# Invite links: url(name, code) and webUrl(name, code) give exactly these; parse() of each gives name and code back.
kind: invite
name: Casa di Nonna & co
code: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
url: darkproof://join?name=Casa%20di%20Nonna%20%26%20co&code=K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ
web: https://darkproof.app/join#name=Casa%20di%20Nonna%20%26%20co&code=K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ

kind: invite
name: Zoë's 🏠
code: our secret+code=1&2 ünïcode#x
url: darkproof://join?name=Zo%C3%AB%27s%20%F0%9F%8F%A0&code=our%20secret%2Bcode%3D1%262%20%C3%BCn%C3%AFcode%23x
web: https://darkproof.app/join#name=Zo%C3%AB%27s%20%F0%9F%8F%A0&code=our%20secret%2Bcode%3D1%262%20%C3%BCn%C3%AFcode%23x

# parse(link): name and code, or not an invite when they are missing.
kind: invite-parse
link: darkproof://join?name=Casa%20di%20Nonna&code=abc+def%20ghi
name: Casa di Nonna
code: abc+def ghi

code: K7QF-2M9X-PA4T-W8RJ

# Check-ins: CheckIn.text(battery, spot, needs, people) gives text; of(), needs(), people(), battery() and spot() read
# the same values back.

battery: 23

# Reports about others: Vouch(subject, status, needs, people, spot).text gives text; Vouch.of(text) gives them back.

# "Are you safe?": AreYouSafe(to).text gives text; AreYouSafe.of(text) gives `to` back (no `to`: everyone).
kind: ask
text: ❓ Is everyone safe?

kind: ask
to: Marco
text: ❓ Marco, are you safe?

# Place freshness: Place.freshness(ts = now - age_ms, now) for each age_ms=result.
kind: place-freshness
cases: -60000=fresh 0=fresh 86400000=fresh 86400001=old 604800000=old 604800001=expired
